changelog:
## 🪲 Bug Fixes

* Fixed injected menu items not closing the Jellyfin user-menu popover after navigation (PR #20, @n00bcodr).
* Fixed Plugin Pages injection sometimes failing on clients where jQuery had not finished loading, including affected Android clients (PR #20, @n00bcodr).
* Added cache-busting to the injected script so clients reliably receive updated versions.

## ⚠️ Compatibility

* Dropped support for Jellyfin 10.11 releases prior to 10.11.11. Jellyfin 10.11.11 remains supported.

### Contributors

* n00bcodr
